I answered Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team: the settled figure is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that number in the channel on Oct 14 as the seat count for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal.

I haven't checked 261 against the contract. No Quarrendon account files are visible to Dana, and I couldn't find the signed renewal. Moss's March 23 digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 and the signed copy was to go to June, but it doesn't give a seat count. I told Dana that June has the signed copy if the tracker needs the figure from the document.

I also told Dana that the other numbers in the channel (180, corrected to 185) come from Amendment No. 1 in Aug 2025, not this renewal. I only looked at #north-team and public files, both of which Dana can see. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post it there.
